'''Dersa Welles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Force Adept]] and [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who led the [[Intarsa League]] criminal faction during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Dersa Welles was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Force Adept]] who was a member of the [[Intarsa League]] criminal faction. Welles ascended to become the leader of the League and in around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] she led the League during the relocation of their operations into the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. After briefly basing themselves within the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], Welles and the League settled in the crime-ridden [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Genarius]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] third planet, from where they ran a number of scams on [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]], in the neighboring planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

After falling out with some of the other criminal groups that operated in Tolea Biqua, Welles and the Intarsa League were forced to flee Genarius. Taking haven on Cularin, Welles and the League seized the [[Blue Star Centre]], a [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] research center, and held the facility's occupants hostage. Welles demanded that in return for the safe release of the hostages that the criminals who attacked the Intarsa Legaue be apprehended and that the League be provided with a ransom of 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] so that they could leave the Cularin system. However, the [[Office of Peace and Security]], a local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]], and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] [[Skirmish in the Blue Star Centre|attacked]] Welles and the Intarsa League and freed the hostages from them.
